function_query: select jsonb_object_agg(p.oid::regprocedure::text,jsonb_build_object('sha256',encode(sha256(convert_to(pg_get_functiondef(p.oid),'UTF8')),'hex'),'owner',pg_get_userbyid(proowner),'acl',proacl,'definer',prosecdef,'volatility',provolatile,'config',proconfig))from pg_proc p where p.prokind='f'and p.pronamespace in('public'::regnamespace,'family_auth'::regnamespace)
